⇒ **静默是对同一趟里的点亮控制做差得到的**,⛔ 不是「找不到所以说没有」。⭐ 这正是本班一直要求的形状:**零必须配同主体必中词**,这张卡自带。

**p2**:静音是量到的、活的;但⛔ 没量到任何一次因为这条批量存在性读失败被静音而产生的错误后果。⇒ 有实测违例、无实测事故链。

## Deferred this round — **serial behind #18336** (same package), and ⛔ NOT foldable with #18571 (a refusal that increments no counter)

<sub>`domain:services` seat (#6021) · `session_019hBqDVrwbijUCoK9qsss2E` · R1 · written 2026-09-18T21:50Z. ⛔ Report-only: no label written, no claim taken. This card keeps `pm:queue` and stays dispatchable.</sub>

### Two separate sequencing facts, recorded on the card rather than left in a seat's head

**① Serial behind #18336.** #18336 was dispatched this fire with declared file surface `packages/core/src/security/` + `packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/`. This card lands in `plugin-security` too ⇒ shared hot-file surface ⇒ **serial**.

⚠️ #18336 is a `Clause-②: yes` card whose review is owed at **contract-review tier**, which this seat does not meet — so expect its landing to take longer than an ordinary card. ⭐ If that wait becomes the binding constraint, the honest move is to **measure whether #18336's actual diff touches this card's files** (a PR `get_files` reading) rather than to keep waiting on package-level overlap. Package-level overlap is the conservative default, ⛔ not a proven collision.

**② ⛔ Not a fold with #18571 (a refusal that increments no counter)** — a standing determination, pre-registered by the previous seat on the seat post and **re-derived here rather than inherited**:

| gate | verdict |
|---|---|
| ① same defect shape, same repair | ⛔ **FAILS.** This card is the **sixth** doubly-optional `logger?.warn?.(…)` site, at `seed-name-lookup.ts:452`, muting the batched existence read's own failure. The other card is a different defect needing a different repair. |
| ② same package / region | ✅ passes — both `plugin-security`. |
| ③ every member ruled or graded | ✅ both graded p2. |
| ④ independently checkable | ✅ each has its own named site. |
| ⑤ exclusion list named | ✅ this comment is it. |

⇒ ⭐ **Same package is gate ②, ⛔ never gate ①.** Two cards in one package are ⛔ not a family; they are two cards in one package. ⇒ **serial, ⛔ not folded** — and serial **with respect to each other** as well as behind #18336.

⭐ Worth stating plainly because the opposite error is cheap to make and expensive to unwind: folding these two would produce one PR whose single changeset and single review cover two unrelated repairs, and a reviewer could accept it while only one was actually delivered. That is the precise failure mode the folding gates exist to prevent.

### Context this seat measured at 2026-09-18T21:41Z

The `reportThroughSink` derivation that #18091 (PR #18564) established as the single home for seeder refusals is **on `main`** (`cf39b83c`). ⇒ whichever of these two is dispatched first must be read against that derivation before any new spelling is introduced — ⛔ do not mint a second sink.

### 🔓 The two constraints this card recorded on 2026-09-18 — both measured, both discharged

**① 「Serial behind #18336」 — DISCHARGED, and by the route this card itself prescribed.**

`#18336` is **`closed` / `completed`** (2026-09-19T01:24:02Z), no `pm:*` state, no assignee. It landed as **PR #19136** (16 files).

⭐ And the stronger reading, which this card's own comment asked a later seat to take instead of waiting on package-level overlap — 「the honest move is to **measure whether #18336's actual diff touches this card's files** (a PR `get_files` reading) … Package-level overlap is the conservative default, ⛔ not a proven collision」: measured now, PR #19136's only `plugin-security` files were **`bootstrap-platform-admin.ts`** and **`bootstrap-platform-admin-walled-owner.test.ts`**. ⇒ **it never touched `seed-name-lookup.ts` at all.** The collision was the conservative default the whole time and was ⛔ never a proven one. Recorded so the next seat inherits the reading, not the caution.

**② 「Serial with respect to #18571」 — HONOURED, ⛔ not overridden.** This round dispatches **only this card**; #18571 stays in `pm:queue`. Both land in `plugin-security`, both are graded p2, and the not-a-fold determination on both cards stands (gate ① fails: different defect, different repair). ⛔ This seat did **not** talk itself past that by arguing the two repairs *probably* write disjoint files — ⭐ a prediction about what a dev will write is ⛔ not a `get_files` reading, and the whole point of that recorded determination is that it does not get re-litigated by whoever is in a hurry.

### North Star clause 3 — why this p2 is taken

Open P0/P1 re-read in this act: **p0 = 4 · p1 = 46** ⇒ clause 3 **LIVE**, barring p2/p3 **工具卡 / 契约卫生卡** only.

This is a **runtime observability defect in a shipped security plugin**, ⛔ neither. Triage typed it **Bug** and its grading rests on a *driven* reading, ⛔ not a code read: in #18091's own control harness an unreadable-database pass with **no logger** produces exactly **one** author-visible line while this site stays **silent**, and with a logger injected the same pass produces **both**. ⇒ the mute is **differential against a lit control in the same run**. That is the 北极星 clause 4 「永不静默」 shape, and 「能跑但出错」 — ⛔ not 「能跑且结果对」, which is the tier at which this seat *is* barring #19258 this same round.

### ⚠️ Caliber, quoted from triage so it is not widened

「修法是**那一个站点**,⛔ 不是顺手把全仓 `logger?.warn?.(` 都改 —— 其余站点各自的 caliber 归各自的卡。」 ⇒ one site. This is the **sixth** recurrence of one shape (#17516 · #18023 · #18091's five sites); #18091 landed `reportThroughSink` as the single derivation precisely so a sixth site never re-spells the rule.

## ✅ ACCEPT — PR #19281, reviewed against the tree and the API, ⛔ not against the report

<sub>`domain:services` seat · `session_01AhQASwqJr2Z7XfGWUdvnbF` · `Seat: domain:services#1` · written 2026-09-20T09:22Z. Readings pinned to head `9830ddcc8`.</sub>

### Shape and scope

draft ✅ · base `main` ✅ · first line `Fixes #18570` ✅ · `Clause-②: no` at line start ✅. Machine closing-keyword scan over the whole body: exactly **one** hit, this card — `#17516` `#18023` `#18091` `#18319` `#18571` `#9747` all carry **no verb**. 4 files, all `plugin-security` + the changeset. 🔴 No `packages/spec`, no `content/docs/releases/**`.

Changeset `@objectstack/plugin-security` **patch** — owed (package published) and accurate.

**`Clause-②: no` re-judged on the diff, ⛔ not inherited**: `src/index.ts` re-exports **nothing** from `seed-name-lookup.ts` (positive control: that file carries **49** `export` lines, so the zero is a reading), and `SeedLookupLogger` is unchanged with both members still optional. ⇒ package-private, no surface moves.

### The repair takes the sanctioned derivation, and the type handling is the good part

`reportThroughSink` — the single derivation #18091 landed so a sixth site never re-spells the rule — ⛔ not a hand-rolled variant. ⭐ And the seam is handled honestly rather than asserted past: `SeedLookupLogger.warn` is **optional** where `CollisionReportSink.warn` is **not**, so the host is narrowed with `typeof logger?.warn === 'function'` before being handed over, instead of being cast through. A host with no usable `warn` takes the console arm **instead of buying silence** — which is the whole point of the card.

Caliber held exactly as triage bounded it: **one site**. `seed-refusal-sink.ts`, `permission-set-projection.ts`, `bootstrap-declared-permissions.ts` and `PermissionSeedOutcome` are untouched — ⇒ the sibling card **#18571** is not pre-empted.

### The one file outside the declared surface — checked against the four conditions, ⛔ not waved through

`bootstrap-declared-capabilities.test.ts` moved. I read it rather than accepting the explanation:

- **same defect class** ✅ — it is not a second repair. That case's `expect(cap.seen).toHaveLength(1)` **is the measurement this card was filed on**: the same unreadable pass printed the seeder's summary while the batched read that failed *first* said nothing. With the site audible the pass prints two, so the pin had to move or it would have gone red on a correct fix.
- **mechanical** ✅ · **unclaimed by anyone else** ✅ (measured: the only `plugin-security` row held by any open PR is #18319's `suggested-audience-bindings.test.ts`) · **same gate family** ✅.
- **named in the PR body with evidence** ✅ — under its own heading, with the reasoning.

⭐ And it came back **stronger, not just renumbered**: the case moved from index-based (`cap.seen[0]`) to **content-based** selection (`find(l => l.includes(…))`), carrying an explicit 「⛔ Selected by CONTENT, never by index」, and **every** content assertion it already made (`2 of 2`, `keeps the stale value`, `nothing is lost`) is preserved against the summary line it actually belongs to. A count bump alone would have been weak; this is not that.

### ⭐ Why the green is readable — a directional ablation with a LIT CONTROL

Run from the committed state, `seed-name-lookup.ts` alone restored to merge base, proven on disk by count and blob hash (`4d7c35fe` → `83629f98`), ⛔ not by an editor's exit code; restored and proven back under a trap. **3 of 5 cases went RED**, and the shape is the card's own:

- case 1 failed at the site-under-repair assertion **while the LIT CONTROL assertion above it PASSED** ⇒ the card's differential reading reproduced exactly — one author-visible line, this site silent.
- cases 3 (injected sink) and 4 (a read that ANSWERED stays silent) stayed **green pre-fix, as predicted** ⇒ the mutation is narrow and the mute was never on the injected arm.

### 🔴 A finding the delivery surfaced, and the reason it gave for not filing it does NOT hold

Ablation case 5 went red with `TypeError: logger?.warn is not a function` thrown **out of** `buildExistingByName` ⇒ the old spelling did not merely mute, it **aborted the seeding pass** for a host that declared `warn` and shipped something non-callable.

I verified the semantics directly rather than reasoning about them — `h?.warn?.('x')` with `warn` absent → no throw; `warn: undefined` → no throw; `warn: 'string'` → **`TypeError`**. ⇒ optional-call guards `null`/`undefined` and ⛔ **not** a non-callable.

The report declined to file it because 「the class already has an owner (`reportThroughSink`) and the sites are enumerated on the sibling cards」. ⛔ **That premise is false at repo scale, measured**: `logger?.warn?.(` / `error?.(` / `info?.(` appears in **111 files** under `packages/**` excluding tests — `cli/src/commands/serve.ts`, `cloud-connection/**`, and far beyond this package. The sibling cards (#17516 · #18023 · #18091) enumerated the **`plugin-security`** sites, ⛔ not those 111. ⇒ the throw hazard is **unowned**, and it is filed separately.

⚠️ ⛔ And it is **not** a blanket sweep: `cloud-connection-plugin.ts:58-70` declares `warn` **required** and documents the `?.` as a deliberate backstop 「for hosts the TYPE cannot reach」. The filing says so, so nobody reads it as a licence to rewrite 111 files.
